title: Indian Air Force Recruitment 2027 – Agniveervayu Intake 02/2027
overview: The Indian Air Force invites applications for the Agniveervayu Intake 02/2027 program. This recruitment is for a four-year engagement period, offering a structured salary package and potential for permanent enrollment in the regular cadre. Candidates will undergo a multi-phase selection process including online testing, physical fitness, and medical examinations.
description:
Post Name

Agniveervayu (Intake 02/2027)

Vacancy Details

Category

Details

Total Vacancy

Not specified

Allocation

State-wise vacancies are allocated

Pay Scale

  • 1st Year: ₹30,000/- per month
  • 2nd Year: ₹33,000/- per month
  • 3rd Year: ₹36,500/- per month
  • 4th Year: ₹40,000/- per month
  • Additional Benefits: Plus applicable Risk and Hardship allowances, Dress, and Travel allowances.

Educational Qualification

  • Science Subjects: Intermediate/10+2/Equivalent with Mathematics, Physics, and English with minimum 50% marks in aggregate and 50% marks in English. OR Three years Diploma Course in Engineering (Mechanical/Electrical/Electronics/Automobile/Computer Science/Instrumentation Technology/Information Technology) with 50% marks in aggregate and 50% marks in English. OR Two years Vocational Course with non-vocational subjects (Physics and Mathematics) with 50% marks in aggregate and 50% marks in English.
  • Other than Science Subjects: Intermediate/10+2/Equivalent in any stream/subjects with minimum 50% marks in aggregate and 50% marks in English. OR Two years Vocational Course with minimum 50% marks in aggregate and 50% marks in English.

Age Limit

Candidates must be born between 01 July 2005 and 01 January 2010 (both dates inclusive). The upper age limit as on the date of enrolment should be 22 years.

Application Fee

Fee Amount: ₹550/- plus 18% GST (Non-refundable).

Selection Process

  1. Phase-I: Online Test (Objective Type).
  2. Phase-II: Physical Fitness Test (PFT), Adaptability Test-I, and Adaptability Test-II.
  3. Phase-III: Medical Examination.

Exam Pattern

  • Science Subjects: 60 minutes duration; comprises Physics, Mathematics, and English (10+2 CBSE syllabus).
  • Other than Science Subjects: 45 minutes duration; comprises English (10+2 CBSE syllabus) and Reasoning & General Awareness (RAGA).
  • Marking Scheme: 1 mark for every correct answer, 0 for unattempted, and 0.25 deduction for each wrong answer.

Important Dates

Event

Date

Online Registration

06 July 2026 to 26 July 2026

Online Exam

22-23 September 2026

PSL Display

Last week of May 2027

Enrolment List

After 01 June 2027

How to Apply

  1. Visit the official portal: https://iafrecruitment.edcil.co.in.
  2. Step-I: Register using personal and contact details to receive User-ID and password.
  3. Step-II: Re-login to fill in personal, communication, and qualification details.
  4. Upload required documents (Photograph, Signature, Parent's Signature, Left Thumb Impression).
  5. Submit the application and pay the fee via the online payment gateway.
  6. Print the submitted application form for future reference.

Important Notes

  • Marital Status: Candidates must be unmarried.
  • Tattoos: Permanent body tattoos are not permitted (with specific exceptions for inner forearms/tribal customs).
  • ESM Status: Candidates are not entitled to Ex-Servicemen (ESM) status after the four-year engagement.
  • Regular Cadre: Up to 25% of each batch may be enrolled in the regular cadre of the Indian Air Force after four years, subject to performance and organizational requirements.
  • Exam Day: Candidates must carry a colour printout of the Admit Card and original AADHAAR card (or other valid ID for J&K, Ladakh, Assam, and Meghalaya) to the exam center.
